normalization: Each of two feature blocks row-L2 normalized, divided by sqrt(2). Float64 regression.
kernel: exp(-gamma * sum(weight * squared_distance)) then training-only centering
target: Original price unit from train.csv (1000 USD); train-only mean/std for linear Ridge.
historical_selection_caveat: Splits, hyperparameters and mixture weights have been researched previously; not a new blind validation.
gpu_role: Optional frozen visual encoding; no vision weight updates in these four methods.
final_refit: Fit each fixed method once on all 8000 training labels; predict original 3000 test IDs. No model selection from test labels/scores.
